newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via three-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via three-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York is expected to add reserves to the banking system via three-day fixed system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"We're expecting a three-day system today," said an economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS Internatinal Inc also expect the Fed to add reserves through term system repruchase agreements.
At 0945 EST/1445 GMT, the federal funds rate was trading at 5-3/8 percent, above the Fed's current 5-1/4 percent target. (( -- N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1676 ))
